x402 paid $0.002 USDC on Base only (asset 0x833589..., payTo 0xF22e558a...); no Solana option, no API key / no sign-in.
usage.guide: List every outbound link on a public web page in one paid call — for crawler seeding or agent navigation. GET https://api.agentstools.dev/links with query param 'url' set to the URL-encoded public http(s) page URL (required); optionally add same_host_only=true to keep only same-host links (default false). No request body. Pay $0.002 USDC via x402 on Base (no API key). Read the result from the top-level 200 JSON: 'links' is de-duplicated absolute URLs each with anchor 'text', 'internal_count'/'external_count' split on the page host, 'feeds' lists any declared RSS/Atom/JSON feeds, and 'sitemap_hint' gives the robots.txt sitemap URL; 'truncated' flags when the 1000-link cap was hit. Browserless and robots.txt-respecting. Verified 2026-08-07 with url=https://example.com -> HTTP 200, $0.002 charged, returned 1 external link plus counts.

entries.name: Strale URL to Markdown
entries.description: Converts any URL into clean, article-quality markdown, stripping navigation, ads, and boilerplate (renders JavaScript pages via fallback).

url.description: URL to convert to markdown

usage.callShape: GET https://api.strale.io/x402/url-to-markdown?url=<page-url> (optional &include_links=true&include_images=true)
usage.outputShape: top-level body.title (string), body.markdown (clean article markdown string), body.word_count (integer), body.url (source url); payment/provenance meta at body._meta
quirks: Required input is the query param 'url' (this is a GET, not a POST body). Optional booleans include_links / include_images add hyperlinks/images to the markdown output.
usage.guide: Pass the page you want to read as the query param 'url' to GET https://api.strale.io/x402/url-to-markdown. Payment is x402 USDC on Base (~$0.054/call, settled synchronously). The 200 body returns { title, markdown, word_count, url }; read body.markdown for the clean article text. Add &include_links=true or &include_images=true to keep links/images. It renders JavaScript pages via a fallback renderer, so it works on dynamic sites too.
